Diagnosis: stock checking, decrementing, and reservation recording were separate Redis commands, allowing concurrent workers to pass the same stock check.
The fix performs all three operations atomically in a Redis Lua script, preserving the existing keys and contract.
Verification: PHPUnit passes all 3 tests and `git diff --check` is clean.
